description: Privacy policy analyzer — Analyze a privacy policy from url= (fetched and extracted) or text=: what personal data is collected, sources, purposes, who it is shared with, whether data is sold or used for targeted ads, sensitive data (location, biometrics, health, children), retention, user rights and how to exercise them, jurisdictions (GDPR, CCPA). Returns a 0-100 privacy score, A-F grade, verdict PRIVACY_FRIENDLY / STANDARD / INVASIVE with reasons, offline keyword checks, and red flags with quotes verified verbatim. Not legal advice. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: ai_privacy_policy
